programme.title: E6 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: Why do my feet hurt?', Tag asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: E5 - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: E7 - Song Of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: E8 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: E9 - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: E88 - Listen
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.title: E2 - Peekaboo
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing as they play Peekaboo.

programme.title: E29 - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: E30 - Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: E31 - Onesies

programme.title: E32 - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: E11 - Grudge Match
programme.desc: Raul, the Brazilian tank engine, wants to beat Thomas in a game. But Raul's super-competitive nature soon gets him into trouble.

programme.title: E36 - Go Jet Academy: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: It's a rainy day and the team are stuck inside, so Foz reads them his favourite book: Around the World in 80 Days by Jules Verne. The Go Jetters are soon imagining they are characters from the story.

programme.title: E29 - Flap Away Home
programme.desc: When a lost bird takes a liking to Bo, it is up to Mojo to fly it home. But it's a stormy trip, and Bo will need to do some flying of his own!

programme.title: E38 - Evil Peamobile Goes Rogue
programme.desc: Evil Pea adds a voice control feature to her Evil Peamobile, but when she calls it a nitwit, the car decides to teach her a lesson.

programme.title: E6 - Veggie Birthday Song
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team have a veggie birthday song for you. Sing and dance along!

programme.title: E7 - How To Be A Nitwit Superhero Song
programme.desc: Evil Pea is tired of everyone always cheering for Supertato. In this song she looks at all the things that make Supertato super, but realises that she loves being evil!

programme.title: E2 - The Duck Badge

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won't find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today's world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: E48
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: E3 - 龐博解鎖棋局博弈
programme.desc: 張泉靈、黃聖依等擔任少年見證官，在賽制內容上進行升級，分為搶位賽、團隊輪答賽、項目挑戰賽三個環節，圍繞真實生活場景與綜合性課題，著重考驗自主探究與協作破題的綜合能力；題庫覆蓋校內學科、傳統文化、時事邏輯等多領域，讓少年們在解題中感受思考的樂趣，在挑戰中養成自主探究的習慣。

programme.title: E42 - 必須了解到麻醉常識
programme.desc: 全新研發的大型互動健康科普節目；從「重治療」到「重預防」，加大醫療健康知識的深度普及，把權威的資訊送到身邊。

programme.title: E5 - 無錫vs常州
programme.desc: 「2026蘇超」由全省13個設區市分別組建1支代表隊，球隊以城市命名；分為常規賽和淘汰賽兩個階段，常規賽中，13支參賽球隊將進行主客場單循環較量，共計22輪比賽；淘汰賽階段，排名前八的球隊將採用單回合淘汰賽制產生四強，直至最終決賽。

programme.title: E4 - Lions Pt 2
programme.desc: Locked in a dark cell in an illegal zoo is an adult lion who became known as Ivan -Asen. A result of generations of inbreeding at Razgrad Zoo, Bulgaria, he’s in extremely bad condition, with skeletal deformations as a result of growing up with no room to move. He was rescued by animal welfare organization, Four Paws and has been rehabilitating in Sofia Zoo. It’s a temporary holding facility while Four Paws find a long-term sanctuary equipped to care for a lion in his condition as he will need specialized care and pain medication for the time that he lives.He’s about to make the journey to his forever home. After weeks of crate training the veterinarians who specialize in large animal transports Marc and Juno are relieved that Ivan- Asen doesn’t need to be tranquilized to be moved into the crate. He walks in willingly. After beginning a life in such hellish conditions, Ivan-Asen is on the road to recovery. The team first have to navigate the Balkan Mountain ranges in the middle of winte

programme.title: E5 - Queensland
programme.desc: Known as ‘The Sunshine State,’ Queensland is a region of spectacular beauty and adventurous possibilities. In this episode, we highlight some of the standout activities available to visitors in this incredible state. Traverse the pristine wilderness of K’gari, the world’s largest sand island, witness the humpback whale migration from the sheltered waters of Platypus Bay, and come face to face with Australia’s cutest animals at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary.

programme.title: E1 - Terry's Criminal Minds
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink. We test fire multiple handguns underwater to see if you can actually penetrate a car windshield and save the victim.

programme.title: E2 - Shark Go Boom
programme.desc: In this iconic scene, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: E5 - Ex-Men: The Origin of Terry
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test a famous scene from X-men. They are attempting to see if you can split a bullet with a Katana sword

programme.title: E1 - A Pirate’s Life for Terry
programme.desc: Terry and Larry go on a swashbuckling adventure when they test two scenes from the 1920’s film, The Black Pirate starring Douglas Fairbanks, Senior. Terry will see if he can knock down a ships mast with a canon, and then test gravity as he slides down a sail with only a knife.

programme.title: E4 - Meet The Smiths
programme.desc: Terry finally gets to compare himself to Brad Pitt!! Terry and Larry test 3 scenes from the action film Mr. and Mrs. Smith. Can a refrigerator or elevator door protect our heroes? Also, can you ignite a gas line with just a bullet? Larry may not look as stunning as Angelina Jolie, but he will help Terry find out the answers.

programme.title: E2 - Feral Hogs
programme.desc: The feral hog is one of the most formidable species on the planet. Possessing a unique combination of high reproductive capacity, size, and adaptability, the feral hog absolutely decimates entire ecosystems. programme.title: Hiss..
programme.desc: Desperate to cure his brain cancer, George captures a cobra, triggering a deadly quest for revenge from its vengeful female counterpart. Immortality comes at a price!

programme.title: E6 - End of Summer
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: E1 - The Little Penguin
programme.desc: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

programme.title: E4 - The Feathering Nest
programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Wherever they live, these birds have got their work cut out, holding their territory against invaders, attracting and winning partners and safeguarding their chicks.

programme.title: E4 - South America
programme.desc: Learn how South America’s rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforest’s oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the sun’s scorching UV rays.

programme.title: E2 - Moonlit Romance
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: E3 - Guided By the Moon
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: E5 - Sloth Bear
programme.desc: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

programme.title: E3 - The Young Ones
programme.desc: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

programme.title: E7 - Cambodia: Hidden Refuges
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekong’s mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.title: E9 - Vietnam: Life in the Delta
programme.desc: The final country on the Mekong’s journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnam’s crown, a biological treasure trove.

programme.title: E1 - Back to School
programme.desc: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumba’s first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.

programme.title: E6 - Graduation Day
programme.desc: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who aren’t all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a grade.

programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: E5 - Sloth Bear
programme.desc: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

programme.title: E3 - The Young Ones
programme.desc: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

programme.title: E7 - Cambodia: Hidden Refuges
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekong’s mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.title: E9 - Vietnam: Life in the Delta
programme.desc: The final country on the Mekong’s journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnam’s crown, a biological treasure trove.

programme.title: E1 - Back to School
programme.desc: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumba’s first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.

programme.title: E6 - Graduation Day
programme.desc: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who aren’t all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a grade.

programme.title: E15

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: Yuka Miyoshi: Beautiful Sister's Endless Climax
The Rising Star -Tang Lai Ying
programme.desc: Tang Lai Ying, known as “All-bad-angles pretty girl”, played a club girl-wannabe waitress in the film “Night King” and her comedic performance has won the audience's favor. Despite her cheerful and optimistic personality both on and off screen, she has experienced confusion on her journey to pursue her dreams. Despite of the popularity of her comedic image, she also longs for audiences to see her serious side. In this programme, Lai Ying is going to share her philosophy on happiness, giving everyone a glimpse of her most authentic self.

programme.title: Throw Down
programme.desc: Pub Manager / band leader Sze-to was once the greatest Jodo fighter around until he unexpectedly gave up the sport for no apparent reason. nowadays Sze-to lives the life of an alcoholic gambler with no hope for the future, until cocky Judo enthusiast Tony shows up at the door and challenges Sze-to into a duet, Old Foe Kong demands finishing the match that never took place years ago; Sze-to mentor Master Cheng asks him to manage his rundown Dojo... All of a sudden, Sze-to's pub turns into an arena where the greatest Judo fighters show off their skills.... Sze-to will take on his opponents with everything he's got.

programme.title: Don't Buy The Seller
programme.desc: ‘Soo-hyun' buys a used washing machine online after moving into her new place. When she receives a broken machine, she realizes she's been scammed and decides to make sure the seller doesn't get away with it! Eventually, Soo-hyun succeeds in finding the seller's online account, then leaves warnings that he is a fraudster under all his posts to stop him from selling. From then on, terrifying things start to happen to Soo-hyun. She led on ordinary life with an ordinary job, but everything in her daily life begins to fall apart, and an investigation to find the seller unfolds. Later, Soo-hyun goes to the seller's pace with Detective Joo, and discovers a dead body...

programme.desc: GV Broadway Cinema is the oldest cinema in the city and it'll be demolished soon. The cinema has always been dark and cold, so it became the last place for the ghost to stay. Yang Yang found a temporary job in the cinema. But this is the last day of his job, so he brings his girlfriend Yiu-yiu to watch the last movie, not realizing a horrible nightmare is coming...

programme.title: Three…Extremes
programme.desc: A trio of disturbing short films from 3 top Asian directors makes up this terrifying anthology, 'Dumplings' by Fruit Chan; 'Cut' by Chan-wook Park and 'Box' by Takashi Miike.

programme.title: Final Run
programme.desc: MA and KAU were the Senior Inspectors of Narcotics Bureau. They were smuggling with the Golden Triangle in Thailand. CHEUNG – an officer of Custom Department. CHEUNG and MA were good friend since they studied in the University. MA's group wanted to get more help in custom, he asked CHEUNG to be his partner, but CHEUNG refused. While KAU was very hasty, he killed all CHEUNG's family. Then, CHEUNG wanted to take revenge against them. However, MA and KAU made a plan to get CHEUNG into trouble. At last, CHEUNG escaped to Thailand and stayed at his aunt's house. MA and KAU knew that CHEUNG escaped to Thailand, so they tried their best to kill him, but they did not succeed...
